get.summary:
Returns the generic wallet currencies configured for this deployment. Provisioning
and migration callers use this instead of duplicating currency ids in product code.

post.summary: Record (or upsert by TransactionId) a Holder earning entry.

get.summary: Read paged ledger + totals. period ∈ {today, weekly, monthly, custom}.

Reads transactions by the caller's opaque external reference. Wallet-service assigns
the value no meaning; several transactions may share one reference, so this is a list.

Total credited into the holder's wallet over the period. The type/tag and wallet-type
filters are caller-supplied and opaque; repeat excludeType to exclude several types.

put.summary:
Idempotently creates a holder and any missing zero-balance wallets in one transaction.
Useful for migration/backfill and safe under concurrent callers.

HolderEarningDto.description: One row of the earnings ledger as returned by the read API.

HolderEarningsResponse.description: Period totals plus paginated rows. Powers the mobile dashboard (T-MOB-019).

transactionId.description:
External transaction reference. Used for idempotency: re-posting the same
TransactionId for the same HolderId returns the existing row unchanged.

deliveryId.description: Optional delivery id this earning is tied to.

tierName.description: Snapshot of tier name at the time of earning. Free-form, nullable.

type.description: Earning type: delivery, tip, bonus, adjustment, reversal.

gross.description: Gross customer-facing amount. Must be >= 0 (reversals use negative is not allowed; use Type=reversal with a positive Gross to represent an offsetting movement).

commissionPercentage.description:
Optional explicit commission percentage. If null, the service applies
WalletService.Domain.HolderEarningsService.DefaultCommissionPercentage.

commission.description:
Explicit commission, stored verbatim and never recomputed from the percentage (BR-16).
WalletService.DTOs.Requests.RecordHolderEarningRequest.CommissionPercentage must be supplied with it as the rate snapshot.

goodsCost.description: Caller-supplied cost of goods. Carried only; not part of gross/commission/net.

insurance.description: Caller-supplied insurance amount. Carried only; not part of gross/commission/net.

minimumFeeApplied.description: Caller's statement that a flat minimum fee, not the percentage, set the commission.

deliveredAt.description: UTC datetime the delivery completed. Defaults to UtcNow if omitted.

RecordHolderEarningRequest.description:
Request body for POST /v1/holders/{holderId}/earnings.
All money fields are System.Decimal — never float — and quantization
happens server-side so clients can supply any precision and get the canonical
2dp ledger row back.

effectiveAt.description: Caller-supplied effective time (UTC). Null for every pre-existing row.

TransactionLedgerPage.description: A holder-scoped, immutable projection over wallet transaction details.

externalReference.description:
Optional caller-owned reference used for generic transaction lookup. Wallet-service
treats this value as opaque and never assigns product semantics to it.

applyConfiguredFees.description:
Controls whether wallet-service appends fees from its configured fee schedule.
Defaults to `true` for backward compatibility. Callers that already provide
every accounting leg explicitly can set this to `false` without introducing
product-specific rules into wallet-service.

effectiveAt.description:
Optional caller-owned stamp for when the movement took effect. Null keeps today's
behaviour; it never replaces CreatedAt, which stays the server-side write time.
